newsitem.title: USA: Empire of Carolina sells $16 mln securities.
newsitem.headline: Empire of Carolina sells $16 mln securities.

text.p: Empire of Carolina said Thursday that investor groups HPA Associates LLC and EMP Associates LLC have purchased a total of $16 million of Empire preferred stock and warrants.
The $16 million includes $5 million from the conversion of a bridge loan.
The company said it may also sell up to another $5 million of securities, subject to shareholder approval.
It said $15 million of outstanding convertible debentures are being exchanged for newly issued Series C Preferred Stock.
Empire of Carolina Inc designs, develops, manufactures and markets a broad range of basic plastic children's toys.
